title: Stack
summary: Stack was a high-ranking member of the Organization, operating as the trusted right-hand man to Mr. Wilder. A highly skilled strategist and an accomplished spy, he handled tactical operations and ambushes for Mr. Wilder's team as they attempted to seize control of the faction following the the Professor's defeat.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Stack and Mr. Wilder observed the Huntik team at the Organization Central through the cameras and planned to get rid of Dante Vale and his team. Later at the South American Forest, Peru, Stack attempted to ambush the Huntik team with his primary Titan, Dark Dryad, but failed. Later at the Nexus, Stack fought against Zhalia Moon but retreated along with the Organization, by using his Dark Dryad Titan to conceal their exit, when Lok Lambert managed to Powerbond with Baselaird. [Doorway to Huntik]
 plan an attack on the Huntik team]]
Stack, along with Mr. Wilder and Hoffman, went to Tower of Nostradamus, which originally was Nostradamus' tower, to find his magical scrying glass. The Organization members bought tickets but, upon being discovered to be with the Organization, fought with Peter, Billie, and Melee Artist, though Stack was knocked out by a Raypulse Spell cast by Billie, the rest of the Organization managed to defeat the Huntik Foundation operatives. Stack later fought against Zhalia again at the tower after the Huntik team arrived but was defeated when the three Sentry Triclops were awaken and threw the Organization members out of the tower. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Soon after that, Stack and Mr. Wilder planned to ambush the Huntik team at Avalon after spying on them outside the Casterwill's cave. [Cave of the Casterwills] With the Organization on the trail of the Willblade, Stack accompanied Mr. Wilder and Hoffman to Avalon. He then ordered Dark Dryad to return to her Amulet after she defeated Undine. Stack fought against Zhalia again outside the castle of Avalon but retreated with Hoffman once Zhalia's King Basilisk, after accidentally turning Dante to stone, returned him back to normal. [Knight of the Willblade]
]]
After capturing Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Cherit at the Road of Alchemists in Prague, Czech Republic, Stack attempted to escort the three prisoners to Organization HQ, on Mr. Wilder's command. Stack's mission was interrupted when Dante and Zhalia arrived and were joined by Lucas Casterwill, Lane, and Dellix. Stack and his Suits tried their best to overpower Dante and Lucas team but nonetheless failed. [Chasing Void]

As both teams took interest in the Amulet of Void, Stack waited to ambush Dante and his team with his Titan, Dark Dryad, in Klaus's Bookstore. However, when the Blood Spiral stormed the base and their forces dropped in through the roof, Stack pulled Mr. Wilder out of the way of the incoming attacks. He was then defeated by Shauna. [The Blood Spiral]

]]
As part of a plan by Mr. Wilder to infiltrate the Blood Spiral, Stack was sent to join the Spirals and find them the coveted Titan Medusa as proof of his allegiance. He met with Kiel and his Casterwill Hunters, and led them the resting place of the Medusa's Cave, where he attempted to capture her. He summoned Divine Mirror Kagami, now given to him by Mr. Wilder, in an attempt to use Medusa's Stone Gaze ability against her. However, Dante and his team arrived, allowing Lok to retrieve the Amulet of Medusa during the battle, after Stack and Divine Mirror Kagami failed to subdue her. Stack then was knocked out by Kiel and taken prisoner by the Spirals. [Zhalia's Mission] Stack was brought before Tantras who killed him using Venomhand in front of his students, including Zhalia as an undercover agent, to demonstrate what happened to spies. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Stack was an intelligent strategist and schemer who was determined to see the downfall of the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} As Mr. Wilder's right hand man, he was an extremely loyal member of [[the Organization]] despite [[Mr. Wilder]]'s poor and inane decisions and protected Mr. Wilder from oncoming attacks from the [[Blood Spiral]]'s assault. {{source|The Blood Spiral}} Stack's loyalty to both the Organization and Mr. Wilder ultimately cost him his life when he tried to infiltrate the [[Blood Spiral]] but failed. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E27 Dark Dryad Stack.png|thumb|200px|Stack and his favored Titan, [[Dark Dryad]]]]
Stack specialized in espionage and in ambushing the opponent, using fast and agile attacks to take his opponents by surprise, with even Zhalia noting him for his speed. {{Source|S2E27}} [[Tantras]] himself noted that Stack was a powerful [[Seeker]] and was careful not to underestimate him. {{Source|S2E35}} As the most intelligent member of Mr. Wilder's team, Stack was skilled coming up with strategies and finding intel that could be of use to Mr. Wilder's team. He often relied on his [[Dark Dryad]] Titan to ambush opponents, enabling him to then strike while they were vulnerable and distracted. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} {{source|Knight of the Willblade}} {{source|The Blood Spiral}}

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Dark Dryad — TV Series — Stack's Signature Titan, used to entangle and ambush opponents from afar.

 

Divine Mirror Kagami — TV Series — Given by Mr. Wilder to defeat Medusa as part of his plan to infiltrate the Blood Spiral.

 

Strix — TV Series — A standard Organization Titan, Stack used them on Avalon to attack the Huntik team.

}}'''Stack''' was a high-ranking member of [[the Organization]], operating as the trusted right-hand man to [[Mr. Wilder]]. A highly skilled strategist and an accomplished spy, he handled tactical operations and ambushes for Mr. Wilder's team as they attempted to seize control of the faction following the [[the Professor|the Professor's]] defeat. 

== History ==
Stack and [[Mr. Wilder]] observed the Huntik team at the [[Organization Central]] through the cameras and planned to get rid of [[Dante Vale]] and his team. Later at the South American Forest, Peru, Stack attempted to ambush the Huntik team with his primary Titan, [[Dark Dryad]], but failed. Later at the [[Nexus]], Stack fought against [[Zhalia Moon]] but retreated along with the Organization, by using his Dark Dryad Titan to conceal their exit, when [[Lok Lambert]] managed to [[Powerbond]] with [[Baselaird]]. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}}
[[File:S2E29 Wilder Stack.jpg|thumb|170px|Stack and [[Mr. Wilder]] plan an attack on the Huntik team]]
Stack, along with Mr. Wilder and [[Hoffman]], went to [[Tower of Nostradamus]], which originally was Nostradamus' tower, to find his magical scrying glass. The Organization members bought tickets but, upon being discovered to be with the Organization, fought with [[Peter]], [[Billie]], and [[Melee Artist]], though Stack was knocked out by a [[Raypulse]] [[Spell]] cast by Billie, the rest of the Organization managed to defeat the [[Huntik Foundation]] operatives. Stack later fought against Zhalia again at the tower after the Huntik team arrived but was defeated when the three [[Sentry Triclops]] were awaken and threw the Organization members out of the tower. {{source|The Tower of Nostradamus}}


Soon after that, Stack and Mr. Wilder planned to ambush the Huntik team at [[Avalon]] after spying on them outside the Casterwill's cave. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}} With the Organization on the trail of the [[Willblade]], Stack accompanied Mr. Wilder and Hoffman to Avalon. He then ordered Dark Dryad to return to her [[Amulet]] after she defeated [[Undine]]. Stack fought against Zhalia again outside the castle of Avalon but retreated with Hoffman once Zhalia's [[King Basilisk]], after accidentally turning Dante to stone, returned him back to normal. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}
[[File:S2E31 Stack Dante.png|thumb|170px|Stack fights with [[Dante Vale]]]]
After capturing [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], and [[Cherit]] at the [[Road of Alchemists]] in [[Prague, Czech Republic]], Stack attempted to escort the three prisoners to Organization HQ, on Mr. Wilder's command. Stack's mission was interrupted when Dante and Zhalia arrived and were joined by [[Lucas Casterwill]], [[Lane]], and [[Dellix]]. Stack and his [[Suits]] tried their best to overpower Dante and Lucas team but nonetheless failed. {{source|Chasing Void}}

As both teams took interest in the Amulet of [[Void]], Stack waited to ambush Dante and his team with his Titan, Dark Dryad, in Klaus's Bookstore. However, when the [[Blood Spiral]] stormed the base and their forces dropped in through the roof, Stack pulled Mr. Wilder out of the way of the incoming attacks. He was then defeated by [[Shauna]]. {{source|The Blood Spiral}}

[[File:S2E36 Tantras Venomhand Stack.png|thumb|170px|Stack is brutally killed by [[Tantras]]]]
As part of a plan by Mr. Wilder to infiltrate the Blood Spiral, Stack was sent to join the Spirals and find them the coveted Titan [[Medusa]] as proof of his allegiance. He met with [[Kiel]] and his [[Casterwill Hunters]], and led them the resting place of the [[Medusa's Cave]], where he attempted to capture her. He summoned [[Divine Mirror Kagami]], now given to him by Mr. Wilder, in an attempt to use Medusa's Stone Gaze ability against her. However, Dante and his team arrived, allowing Lok to retrieve the Amulet of Medusa during the battle, after Stack and Divine Mirror Kagami failed to subdue her. Stack then was knocked out by [[Kiel]] and taken prisoner by the Spirals. {{source|Zhalia's Mission}} Stack was brought before [[Tantras]] who killed him using [[Venomhand]] in front of his students, including Zhalia as an undercover agent, to demonstrate what happened to spies. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

== Personality ==
Stack was an intelligent strategist and schemer who was determined to see the downfall of the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} As Mr. Wilder's right hand man, he was an extremely loyal member of [[the Organization]] despite [[Mr. Wilder]]'s poor and inane decisions and protected Mr. Wilder from oncoming attacks from the [[Blood Spiral]]'s assault. {{source|The Blood Spiral}} Stack's loyalty to both the Organization and Mr. Wilder ultimately cost him his life when he tried to infiltrate the [[Blood Spiral]] but failed. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

== Abilities ==
[[File:S2E27 Dark Dryad Stack.png|thumb|200px|Stack and his favored Titan, [[Dark Dryad]]]]
Stack specialized in espionage and in ambushing the opponent, using fast and agile attacks to take his opponents by surprise, with even Zhalia noting him for his speed. {{Source|S2E27}} [[Tantras]] himself noted that Stack was a powerful [[Seeker]] and was careful not to underestimate him. {{Source|S2E35}} As the most intelligent member of Mr. Wilder's team, Stack was skilled coming up with strategies and finding intel that could be of use to Mr. Wilder's team. He often relied on his [[Dark Dryad]] Titan to ambush opponents, enabling him to then strike while they were vulnerable and distracted. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}} {{source|Knight of the Willblade}} {{source|The Blood Spiral}}
